3.measure_note: NOT the county form: this is the filer's own typed portrait ledger, and it has NO printed row rules at all (rowbands.py full-width returns 2 rules — the header underline and the total's rule). Measured by the §A2 recovery, `rowbands.py <pdf> 3 --text-lines --col 83,92`, restricted to the amount column: text bands at 13.36 (the 'Amount' header), 14.81 / 16.31 / 17.86 / 19.40 (the four data rows) and 24.00 (the printed total), i.e. a regular pitch of 1.53 pct over four rows. Bands stored as [14.45+1.535k, +1.535]. The column bands in `cells` are read off the printed header rule's extent and the right-aligned amounts, not off rules. THREE-CROP PROOF at 1200 dpi --value: the row-1 box pct:83.5,14.45,8.5,1.53@p3 rendered '500.00'; the row-4 box pct:83.5,19.05,8.5,1.54@p3 rendered '250.00' (the last transcribed row); and the §B5 one-past-the-end control pct:83.5,20.59,8.5,1.53@p3 rendered an EMPTY band under the ledger's closing rule — the printed 4,000.00 total sits far below at 24.0 and is NOT a fifth row.

4.measure_note: Also the filer's own typed ledger, ruleless (rowbands.py full-width returns ZERO rules). Measured by the §A2 `--text-lines --col 82,92` recovery: 21 of the 34 lines resolve as separate text bands (repeated identical figures merge), and those 21 fit a REGULAR PITCH of 1.3858 pct exactly — first data line at 13.97, last (row 32) at 56.93, i.e. 13.97 + 31 x 1.3858 = 56.93 to two decimals, and every detected intermediate band lands on the ladder (row 24 predicted 45.84, detected 45.83; row 31 predicted 55.54, detected 55.52). Bands stored as [13.62 + 1.3858k, +1.3858] for k=0..31, so all 32 rows carry a measured band. FIVE-CROP PROOF at 1200 dpi --value, deliberately including two INTERPOLATED bands: row 1 rendered '500.00'; row 17 (interpolated) rendered '200.00'; row 28 (interpolated) rendered '3,000.00'; row 32 rendered '1,050.00'; and the §B5 one-past-the-end control pct:81.5,57.96,10.0,1.39@p4 rendered an EMPTY band above the total's rule — the printed 44,944.26 sits at 61.07 and is NOT a 33rd row. Because the pitch (1.386) is barely twice the glyph height (0.68), a band can show an ascender sliver of the next line at its lower edge; in every proof crop exactly one figure renders whole and it is the figure recorded for that row.
